_meta.note: Every parameter has value, sourceUrl, verifiedBy (name) and verifiedOn (YYYY-MM-DD). All stay null until Elias verifies them against AADE / the law text. Never fill in estimates. 'description' is documentation only. Candidate values and sources: docs/tax-research.md. Switches (values from a fixed list) are listed with their allowed values in the description.

brackets.description: Income tax scale for employment income, tax year 2026, one scale per number of dependent children. Shape: { "0": Bracket[], "1": Bracket[], "2": Bracket[], "3": Bracket[], "4": Bracket[] } where Bracket = { "upTo": number | null, "rate": number }. upTo is the top of the bracket in EUR of taxable income per year (null = no upper limit, last bracket only), rate is a fraction (0.22 = 22%). If the scale doesn't vary with children, repeat the same list under every key.

upTo25.description: Rate overrides for taxpayers aged up to 25 (age band "upTo25"), applied on top of the 0-children scale. Shape: [{ "from": number, "upTo": number | null, "rate": number }]: within taxable income from..upTo (EUR per year), the rate becomes 'rate'. Use [] if there is no relief.

26to30.description: Rate overrides for taxpayers aged 26 to 30 (age band "26to30"). Same shape as upTo25.

youthChildrenInteraction.description: Switch. How youth relief combines with the per-children scale for a young taxpayer with children. Allowed values: "lowest_rate_per_range" (in each income range the lower of the youth rate and the children rate applies) | "lower_total_tax" (tax is computed once on the children scale and once on the 0-children scale with youth overrides; the lower total applies). Only used when age band is not 31plus and children > 0.

baseAmountByChildren.description: Employee tax reduction (μείωση φόρου, art. 16 ΚΦΕ) in EUR per year by number of dependent children. Shape: { "0": number, "1": number, "2": number, "3": number, "4": number }.

phaseOutThreshold.description: Taxable income in EUR per year above which the tax reduction starts to shrink.

phaseOutRate.description: EUR of reduction lost per EUR 1 of taxable income above the threshold (EUR 20 per EUR 1,000 = 0.02).

phaseOutMethod.description: Switch. Allowed values: "continuous" (reduction shrinks pro rata for every euro above the threshold) | "per_full_1000" (reduction shrinks only per complete EUR 1,000 above the threshold).

employeeRate.description: EFKA employee social contribution rate as a fraction of gross pay (total of all employee contributions; list the components in the source note if they differ).

monthlyInsurableCeiling.description: Monthly insurable-earnings ceiling in EUR above which no employee contributions are due. The engine applies it to each of the salaryPaymentsPerYear equal payments (bonus-payment ceilings are an open item, not modelled).

appliesToEmploymentIncome.description: true / false: whether the special solidarity contribution (art. 43A ΚΦΕ) applies to employment income in tax year 2026.

brackets.description: Solidarity contribution scale: Bracket[] (same shape as one entry of incomeTax.brackets). Only used if appliesToEmploymentIncome is true; if it does not apply, set to [] (still with source and verification).

salaryPaymentsPerYear.description: Number of salary payments per year for private-sector employees (expected 14; verify).

exemptionRate.description: Share exempted under Article 5C, as a fraction (expected 0.5; verify).

exemptionAppliesTo.description: Which items the exemption reduces. Shape: list drawn from ["incomeTax", "solidarityContribution", "socialContributions"]. Use [] if none (unlikely).

exemptionMethod.description: Switch. How the exemption works. Allowed values: "exempt_share_of_income" (exemptionRate of the income is exempt; the tax scale is applied to the remaining income) | "reduce_tax_by_share" (tax is computed on the full income on the normal scale, then reduced by exemptionRate). These differ because the scale is progressive.

exemptionBase.description: Switch. Only used with exemptionMethod "exempt_share_of_income". What the exempt share is taken of. Allowed values: "gross_employment_income" | "net_of_employee_contributions" (gross minus employee EFKA).

reductionPhaseOutIncome.description: Switch. Only used with exemptionMethod "exempt_share_of_income". Which income the art. 16 tax-reduction phase-out is measured against. Allowed values: "after_exemption" (the reduced taxable income) | "before_exemption" (taxable income without the 5C exemption).

reductionOrder.description: Switch. Only used with exemptionMethod "reduce_tax_by_share". Allowed values: "reduce_then_exempt" (final tax = (scale tax − reduction) × (1 − exemptionRate)) | "exempt_then_reduce" (final tax = scale tax × (1 − exemptionRate) − reduction).

youthReliefInteraction.description: Switch. Whether youth relief (incomeTax.youthRelief) also applies to someone under 5C. Allowed values: "stack" (5C exemption applied, youth rates on the remainder) | "no_youth_relief_with_5c" (5C taxpayers are taxed on the normal scale) | "lower_of_two" (the taxpayer gets whichever is lower: 5C without youth relief, or youth relief without 5C). Only used when apply5C is on and age band is not 31plus.

durationYears.description: Number of tax years the 5C exemption applies for. Drives the timeline cliff.

lookbackYears.description: Quiz Q1: length of the look-back window in years for prior Greek tax residence. OPEN ITEM: sources conflict (8 vs 5).

requiredNonResidentYears.description: Quiz Q1: years within the look-back window the person must NOT have been Greek tax resident. OPEN ITEM: sources conflict (7 of 8 vs 5).

minimumStayYears.description: Quiz Q4: minimum years the person must stay in Greece (expected 2; verify).

GB.description: true / false: the United Kingdom meets the administrative-cooperation condition for 5C.

US.description: true / false: the United States meets the administrative-cooperation condition for 5C.

AU.description: true / false: Australia meets the administrative-cooperation condition for 5C.
